name: idea-loop
description: Closed loop from idea to shipped engineering, backed by a docs/ Obsidian vault as its knowledge base. Eight user-invoked skills, no state machine — a file's existence IS its status: a spec exists while the work is in flight, and is deleted once an ADR records why/how/result. grill runs a design-tree interview in frontier rounds (facts are the agent's job, decisions are the human's) until nothing is silently assumed, and when a product decision cannot be settled in prose it calls prototype in-session; prototype is throwaway code answering ONE question — a clickable single-file state model, or structurally distinct gray-box variants — whose artifact and verdict both land in the raw bucket; to-spec lands that conversation as a raw transcript plus one spec (problem, user stories, implementation + testing decisions, agreed seams); to-ticket slices a spec into tracer-bullet vertical cuts with blocking edges, each a temporary credential deleted on merge, and holds the design-freeze gate for UI work; implement turns one ticket into one commit in a fresh session, driving TDD at the seams the spec already agreed and never reopening the plan — on a UI ticket it runs the measurement/pixel comparators so visual correctness is a test that can go red — then hands off to pr-open-review (push, open PR, round-1 three-axis review) and pr-fix-verify (one round of agreed fixes, then re-review) — Correctness / Standards / Spec run in parallel and never merged or reranked; dreaming reconciles every doc against origin/main — including CLAUDE.md — and proposes disposals the human approves before anything moves. The design side lives here too, not as a separate plugin: the taste and craft references under references/design/ (core law, DESIGN.md format, surface/module/component altitude protocols, the static-UI and motion protocols), a deterministic design-lint hook that fires on writes to design-preview/ and design-motion-preview/ HTML, and a headless Playwright MCP server. Generalized out of a real project (Toeflair) — reads the current repo's own CLAUDE.md and lint/typecheck config rather than hardcoding either. Skills own the mechanics; the human owns every judgement call.
